The National Institute for Japanese Language and Linguistics (NINJAL) article on これ/それ/あれ, lines 43 and 62-89, confirms それ as the middle-distance demonstrative, its use for hearer-domain referents, and neutral anaphoric reference. This supports the article’s caution against a one-to-one Spanish translation.

The simple “close to hearer or previously mentioned” rule is an approximation: the NINJAL explanation adds distance, discourse deixis and neutrality; the entry should avoid implying the approximation exhausts それ’s distribution.

That source does not cover the full paradigm これ・それ・あれ・どれ, its pronoun/nominal-predicate examples, or the claim that それ can stand alone while その requires a noun; those claims need separate grammatical/lexical locators.
The example translations and politeness of それをください were not independently corpus-checked.

NINJAL and TUFS support middle-distance and contextual/discourse uses of それ, but not every article assertion: full paradigm, それ alone versus その+N, specific politeness gloss, and the article’s example translations remain unverified.
Cotejo nuevo: NINJAL cubre usos de それ, pero no autonomía pronominal, contraste そのN ni todos los ejemplos y cortesía.
